tei:div.tei:p: "$ ༄༅// 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo bzhugs so//

༄༅// rgya gar skad du/ ār+ya mahā ba la nā ma ma hā yā na sū tra/ bod skad du/ 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// 'di skad bdag gis thos pa dus gcig na/ bcom ldan 'das ri btang zung chen po na chos ston te/ de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags te/ bkur nas mngon par dga' bar byas pa yang de nyid du 'dug par gyur to// de nas sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das kyi phyag gis sems can rnams dbugs 'byin cing*/ shar phyogs na me lce kun tu 'bar ba'i phreng ba'i pad+ma'i gdan la bzhugs so// bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs na stobs po che lag pa bzhi pa/ lag pa gcig gis ni rnga yab thogs/ lag pa gcig gis ni phyag 'tshal/ g.yas pa na ni be con thogs/ g.yon pa na ni zhags pa thogs/ skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ mig dmar po'o// de'i 'og na ni bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa'o// g.yas na ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po gnod mdzes so// g.yon ni bdud rtsi thabs sbyor ro// de nas snying po rnams ni zla ba kham pa lta bur bzhag go /snying po ni ki li ki la dang*/ 'gro lding ba'i gzungs dang*/ lus dmar po dang*/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa dang*/ rdo rje'i rgyan chen te snying po'i mchog go /rig sngags kyi rgyal po drag po chen po dang nye ba na ni 'phags ma mā ma kī'o// 'phags pa bdud rtsi thabs sbyor gyi 'og na ni rdo rje'i lcags kyu dang rdo rje'i lu gu rgyud do// sgo'i nang logs su ni khro bo rdo rje'i tho ba dang rdo rje'i be con gnyis mngon du phyogs par bzhag go /g.yon logs su ni bcom ldan 'das 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug 'khor dang bcas pa'o// bcom ldan 'das kyi g.yas logs su ni gos dkar mo'o// de'i 'og tu ni sgrol ma dang khro gnyer can no// g.yon du ni rig sngags kyi rgyal po rta mgrin dang*/

de la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po brgya stong phrag dang ngo*// de bzhin du shar phyogs su ni zla ba dang nyi ma dang yul 'khor srung dang dbang po dang*/ me'i phyogs su ni me lha drang srong rnams kyis bskor ba'o// lho phyogs su ni gshin rje dang khyab 'jug go /bden bral gyi phyogs su ni srin po'i bdag po ma mos bskor ba'o// nub phyogs su ni klu'i bdag po klu la sogs pas bskor ba'o// rlung gi phyogs su ni rlung lha 'khor bcas pa'o// byang phyogs su ni lus ngan po 'khor dang bcas pa'o// dbang ldan gyi phyogs su ni dbang ldan tshogs kyis bskor ba'o// lha rnams kyi dbang po brgya byin dang*/ khyab 'jug dang*/ tshangs pa chen po dang*/ de la sogs pa gnas gtsang ma'i ris kyi lha'i bu grangs med dpag tu med pa dag dang ngo*// sangs rgyas bcom ldan 'das 'khor dang bcas te snga ma bzhin no// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje mdo sde 'di sgrub pa po/ 'di la gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di rgya cher yang dag par bshad par bya'o// dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ ki li ki li badz+ra/ ki li kī lā ya swā hā/ spyi gtsug la swā hā/ dpral ba la swā hā/ mig la swā hā/ drag shul can la swā hā/ shin tu drag shul can la swā hā/ rdo rje'i zhags pa la swā hā/ lus dmar po la swā hā/ lag na rdo rje la swā hā/ lag na zhags pa la swā hā/ lag na ral gri la swā hā/ lag na dgra sta la swā hā/ lag na gzhu 'dzin la swā hā/ gtun shing 'dzin la swā hā/ lag na 'khor lo la swā hā/ lag na mdung rtse gsum pa la swā hā/ snying po la swā hā/ nye ba'i snying po la swā hā/ drag po ki li ki la la swā hā/ byis pa ki li ki la la swā hā/ dmar po ki li ki la la swā hā/

stobs po che la swā hā/ ral pa can la swā hā/ gsus 'phyang po la swā hā/ khro bo 'chol pa la swā hā/ gshin rje la swā hā/ srin po ya mun la swā hā/ drag po chen po la swā hā/ sprin la swā hā/ ri 'dzin la swā hā/ ri btang bzung 'dzin la swā hā/ rdo rje be con la swā hā/ 'jigs byed chen po la swā hā/ lus 'jigs byed la swā hā/ bsdigs byed la swā hā/ rdo rje lu gu rgyud la swā hā/ rdo rje'i brtan pa la swā hā/ rdo rje'i lus la swā hā/ 'gro ldang ba la swā hā/ bdud rtsi la swā hā/ dka' thub 'dzin la swā hā/ lcags kyu la swā hā/ don yod la swā hā/ gtsug tor rgyal po la swā hā/ mdog dkar po la swā hā/ sngo bsangs mdog la swā hā/ 'phyang ba po la swā hā/ glang po che la swā hā/ ba glang 'phel gyi lag pa la swā hā/ bdud rtsi rnam par 'phrul ba la swā hā/ sbrul gyi ske rags can la swā hā/ rdo rje'i phur pa la swā hā/ lag pa gnyis ka la swā hā/ a rdo rje la swā hā/ 'bar ba'i 'od byed la swā hā/ blo gros brtan pa'i rdo rje la swā hā/ myu gu la swā hā/ 'od byed la swā hā/ rdo rje rnam par 'joms pa la swā hā/ rdo rje'i dra ba la swā hā/ rdo rje 'jigs byed la swā hā/ rdo rje khu tshur la swā hā/ sprin rnam par 'thor ba la swā hā/ char pa ston pa la swā hā/ rdo rje lcags kyu la swā hā/ rdo rje snying po la swā hā/ rdo rje nye ba'i snying po la swā hā/ mtho ba'i rgyal po la swā hā/ be con rgyal po la swā hā/ go cha'i rgyal po la swā hā/ oṃ dh+ri aṃ/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ hu lu hu lu/ tiṣ+ṭhā tiṣ+ṭha/ ban+dha ban+dha/ ha na ha na/ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ a mṛ te hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ yul 'khor srung la swā hā/ mig mi bzang la swā hā/

'phags skyes po la swā hā/ lus ngan po la swā hā/ dbang po la swā hā/ me la swā hā/ drang srong chen po thams cad la swā hā/ nyi ma la swā hā/ zla ba la swā hā/ gshin rje la swā hā/ khyab 'jug la swā hā/ srin po'i bdag po la swā hā/ klu'i bdag po la swā hā/ rlung lha la swā hā/ dbang bdag la swā hā/ dbang bdag gi chung ma la swā hā/ brgya byin la swā hā/ nor lha'i bu la swā hā/ rdo rje chen po la swā hā/ tshangs pa chen po la swā hā/ sa la swā hā/ dbyangs can la swā hā/ lha mo dpal la swā hā/ lha mo dka' thub zlog la swā hā/ rig sngags chen po stobs po che'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po 'di dkyil 'khor gyi gnas su 'chang zhing yid la byed na/ srung ba dang skyob pa dang sbed pa byed par 'gyur ro// las thams cad kyang 'grub par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun dang*/ rang sangs rgyas dang*/ 'phags pa nyan thos kyi dge 'dun thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// gnas brtan blo gros chen po shā ra dwa ti'i bu la phyag 'tshal lo/ byams pa la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' thams cad la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par song ba rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// yang dag par zhugs pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo// rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ mu ni mu ni/ ma hā mu ni/ ki li ki li/ ma hā ki li ki li/ dhi ke /ka ṭa ka ṭa ka ṭa/ ma hā ka ṭa/ sha ma sha ma sha ma/ ma hā sha ma/ shāṭi shā ṭi shā ṭi/ shān+ta shān+ta shān+ta/ dān+ta dān+ta dān+ta/ dhi ra dhi ra dhi ra/ ma hā me gha du ra dha ra/ ha ri ha ri ha ri/ ku ṭa ṭi ku ṭa ṭi ku ṭa ṭi/ ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da ts+tshin+da/ bin+dha bin+dha bin+dha/ sarba duṣ+ṭān/ gu mu gu mu gu mu/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ pra ma ṇa/ da ma ni da ma ni da ma ni/ ṭa ṭa ṭa/ ṭha ṭha ṭha/ ḍā ḍā ḍā/ ḍā ḍā ḍā/ tsā tsā tsā/ tsa tsa tsa/ pa tsa pa tsa pa tsa/ da ha da ha da ha/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ he he he/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ sha ba ri sha ba ri sha ba ri/

mā taṅgi/ tsan+ḍa lī/ hu hu hu/ dzu hu dzu hu dzu hu/ ha ta pra t+ya thi na/ tsi li tsi li tsi li/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ tiṣ+ṭhā tiṣ+ṭha tiṣ+ṭhā/ tiṣ+ṭha tha tiṣ+ṭha tha tiṣ+ṭha tha/ mā ti kra ma tha/ ma tāṅgi/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ he he he/ gal te mi 'dug na lag pa dang rkang pa dang*/ kha dang mig dang snying dang ngag thams cad bcing ngo*/ dbrog go /dz+wa la dz+wa la dz+wa la/ dun dhu dun dhu dun dhu/ ban dhu ban dhu ban dhu/ nī la nī la nī lāṃ/ ga badz+ra dha re/ stobs po che zhes bya ba'i snying po dran par gyis shig /ko ṭi ko ṭi ko ṭi ni/ sarba bhū tā ni badz+ra mā li/ badz+ra dha ra/ badz+ra aṭ+ṭa hā sa/ tsa ra tu na ra tu ma ra tu/ ku ru ku ru ku ru/ hu ru hu ru hu ru/ sems can chen po dran par gyis shig /hūṃ hūṃ hūm̐/ he he he/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ tsan+ḍa tsan+ḍa tsan+ḍa/ ma hā tsan+ḍa/ hu ra tu/ hu ra tu hu ra tu/ mu ru mu ru mu rugṛh+na gṛh+na gṛh+na/ badz+ra pā ṇi/ ha na ha na ha na/ ma ma sarba sha trū nān/ mūrti tā ḍa ya phaṭa/ ku ru ku ru ku ru/ lag na rdo rje'i las dang 'gal bar ma byed cig /dam tshig las 'gal bar byas na dam tshig dral ba dang*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'ang bslus par 'gyur ro// gsang sngags kyi gzhi ni 'di rnams yin no// tsu tsu tsu/ ha ra ha ra ha ra/ phuṭa ṭu phuṭa ṭu phuṭa ṭu/ ta pa ni ta pa ni ta pa ni/ pa tsa ni pi tsa ni pa tsa ni/ lag na rdo rje'i snying po de bzhin gshegs pas byin gyis brlabs pa dran par gyis shig /tsi li tsi li tsi li/ phu lu phu lu phu lu/ phu phu phu/ bcom ldan 'das gal te bdag gi snying po 'di dang 'gal bar bgyis na/ de bzhin gshegs pas rab tu gsungs pa'i mtshams med pa lnga dang ldan par gyur cig /dar phu/ tsar phu/ nar phu/ rdo rje 'dzin 'khor dang bcas pa la phyag 'tshal lo// bdag la gsang sngags kyi gzhi rnams grub par gyur cig swā hā/ rdo rje 'dzin gzi brjid chen po la phyag 'tshal lo swā hā/ oṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐/

phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ de nas de'i tshe de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas shākya thub pa'i 'i 'od zer kun tu 'bar ba'i snang bas stong gsum gyi stong chen pa'i 'jig rten gyi khams las 'das nas bdud kyi khyim thams cad kun tu 'bar/ rab tu 'bar/ kun tu rab tu mched cing 'bar te/ me lce gcig tu gyur pa kun tu snang ngo*// de ltar gyur pa dang bdud sdig can ral gri dang*/ 'khor lo dang*/ gzhu dang*/ mda' la sogs pa'i mtshon cha rnams lag na thogs te bgegs kyi rnam par 'phrul pa du ma byed do// de nas skad cig de nyid la bdud sdig can bdud kyi rigs kyi lha'i bu thams cad dang lhan cig tu bdud kyi rnam par 'phrul pa chen pos/ bcom ldan 'das ga la ba bzhugs pa der song ngo*// de nas de ltar gyur pa dang*/ khro bo 'chol pa mdog dmar po/ sbrang rtsi ltar mig dmar ser po/ mche ba gtsigs pa mi bzad pa/ skra khams pa gyen du brdzes pa/ lag pa g.yas pa na be con thogs pa/ lag pa g.yon pa na rdo rje thogs pa/ sbrul gyis brgyan pa/ stag lpags kyi sham thabs bgos pa/ shar phyogs su 'jig rten gyi khams gang ga'i klung nyi shu rtsa gcig gi bye ma snyed 'das shing*/ de bzhin du lho dang nub dang byang gi phyogs su yang kun tu snang ngo*// de nas bdud sdig can dang gegs bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag khro bo'i 'chol pas 'dar bar gyur to// bdud sdig can myos shing gzir te/ 'phongs nas srog la mi lta ba dang*/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes zhags pas bcing ba lngas bcings so// de ltar gyur pa dang*/ de'i tshe 'thab bral dang*/ dga' ldan dang*/ 'phrul dga' dang*/ gzhan 'phrul dbang byed kyi lha rnams kyis spos dang*/ me tog dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan sna tshogs la sogs pas bcom ldan 'das la ci nus kyis mchod nas phyogs gcig tu 'khod do// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes sangs rgyas thams cad kyis bstod cing bsngags te/

mngon par dga' bar byas nas bcom ldan 'das kyi rjes su thugs rangs pa mdzad pas/ sems can thams cad kyi don dang*/ lha dang mi rnams la phan pa dang bde ba'i phyir rig sngags mchog gi rgyud chen po'i nang nas don 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa/ stobs po che stobs chen po'i rig sngags kyi rgyal po zhes bya ba'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi 'di dag smras so// gang la la zhig 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston tam/ bsti stang du byed dam/ bla mar byed dam/ rim gror byed dam/ mchod par byed na dkyil 'khor thams cad du zhugs par 'gyur ro// pha rol gyis byas pa'i gsang sngags thams cad bshig pa dang*/ bcom pa dang bsgyel bar yang 'gyur ro// de ltar bcom ldan 'das rdo rje 'dzin gyis rig sngags mchog gi rgyud chen po'i nang nas 'byung ba smras so// de nas gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje bcom ldan 'das kyis rjes su thugs rangs par mdzad pas don 'dod pa thams cad sbyin pa zhes bya ba stobs dpag tu med pa zhes bya ba pha rol gnon pa/ stobs po che'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi smras pa/ oṃ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bi dha na sa ya/ dza ṭi lam+bo dha ra/ u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang la la zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di thos nas 'dzin tam/ 'chang ngam/ klog gam/ gzhan dag la rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston tam/ rim gror bgyid dam/ mchod par bgyid na/ dkyil 'khor thams cad du dbang bskur bar 'gyur ro// gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes gsol ba/ stobs po che'i snying po 'dzin pa la ni gnod sbyin nam gnod sbyin gyi bu'am/

srin po'am srin po'i bu'am/ grul bum mam grul bum gyi bu'am/ nam mkha' lding ngam nam mkha' lding gi bu'am/ klu 'am klu'i bu'am/ dri za'am dri za'i bu'am/ sha za 'am sha za'i bu'am/ smyo byed dam smyo byed kyi bu'am/ mkha' 'gro'am mkha' 'gro'i bu'am/ sgrub pa'am sbrul 'dzin bcas la sogs pa dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ lus srul po dang*/ ro langs la sogs pa dang*/ gnon po'i gdon thams cad dang*/ brjed byed la sogs pa'i gdon thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje legs so legs so// stong pa nyid do// don dam pa stong pa nyid do// phyi ma'i mtha' stong pa nyid do// stong pa nyid stong pa nyid do// chen po stong pa nyid do// de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid do// de nas bcom ldan 'das la gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// gang mdo sde 'di rab tu ston pa de la mchod pa bgyi ba dang*/ phyag bgyi ba dang*/ rim gror bgyi ba dang*/ bskor ba bgyi ba'i 'os su gyur pa lags so// de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa stobs po che'i gsang sngags kyi gzhi smras pa/ oṃ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ lag na mdung rtse gsum thogs pa drag shul can hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ oṃ dz+ya ti ni ra na da/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ oṃ oṃ oṃ/ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ stobs po che la swā hā/ oṃ rdo rje khro bo stobs po che/ ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha ba ki ri/ bi dha na sa ya dza ti lam bo dha ra/ u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ dz+wa la dz+wa la sarba duṣ+ṭan/ stam bha ya stam bha ya/ du rā tsa rā na duṣ+ṭan ni bā ra ya/ bdag la srungs shig srungs shig swā hā/ oṃ a nan+ta/ bi dza ya ma hā tsan+ḍa/ hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dhṛ ka hūṃ phaṭa/

oṃ shi ra ye/ shri ra ma li ni/ si ni si ni/ shi shi ni shi shi ni/ oṃ sarba ā du ma/ ma hā ha dza badz+ra/ a shi ni badz+ra/ pā sha a nu pra bi sha/ sarba duṣ+ṭan/ stam bha ya stam bha ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ hūṃ ban dha ban dha/ hūṃ oṃ a nan+ta/ bi dza ya/ ma hā tsaṇ+ḍe hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa/ badz+ra kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ o badz+ra karta ka ri ka ra ka ra/ ts+tshin da ts+tshin da hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ dha ka dha ka /dza la dz+wa la hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ bi pu ra rak+ṣa badz+ra/ ban dza ra hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ki li ki li/ badz+ra badz+ri bha ra ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ā kar+ṣa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ da ra da ra/ dā ra ya dā ra ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha na ha na/ da ra da ra/ dā ra ya dā ra/ pa ṭa ya pa ṭa ya/ mo ṭa ya mo ṭa ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ta ṭa ta ṭa/ tā ṭa ya tā ṭa ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ dz+wa la dz+wa la/ pra dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ dī pya dī pya/ dī pa ya dī pa ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ tsu ru tsu ru/ u tsuṣ+ma kro dha/ shi kha ra ha ra ha ra hūṃ phaṭa/ dkon mchog gsum la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo// oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā tsan+ḍa ha na da ha/ pa tsa ma tha bi ka ri/ bi dha na sa ya/ bcom ldan 'das tshur gshegs tshur gshegs/ ha na ha na/ ha ra ha ra/ da ha da ha pa tsa pa tsa bi dha na sa ya bi dha na sa ya/ lha dang lha ma yin gyi bdag pos mchod pa thams cad kyi bdag nyid las skyes pa/ gzi brjid chen po su ru su ru mu ru mu ru/ ku ru ku ru/ ghu ru ghu ru/ kurba kurba/ ma hā kurba/ bi kurba/ ku nad ṭi ku nad ṭi/ na ṭi na ṭi/ shi ni shi ni/ khi ni khi ni/ kha kha/ kha hi khā hi/ ku ru ku ru/ tu ṭa tu ṭa tu da ṭa tu da ṭa/ trad ṭa trad ṭa/ tu ru tu ru/ 'byung pa'i bdag po/ klu'i bdag po/ lha ma yin gyi grong khyer rnam par 'joms par byed pa/

khro bo 'chol pa stobs po che/ dha ma dha ma/ ka ra ka ra/ ku ru ku ru/ su ru su ru/ hūṃ phaṭa/ ha na ha na hūṃ phaṭa/ da ha da ha hūṃ phaṭa/ pa tsa pa tsa hūṃ phaṭa/ hrī/ hūṃ hūṃ hūṃ phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ tsu lu tsu lu swā hā/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la sarba duṣ+ṭan/ stam bha ya stam bha ya/ mo ha ya mo ha ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ ha ha/ sa ra sa ra/ bi sa ra bi sa ra/ gha ta ya gha ta ya/ oṃ bi sa ra/ san trā sa ya hūṃ phaṭa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la/ ha ra ha ra/ kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ nā sha ya nā shā ya/ hūṃ phaṭa/ hūṃ hūṃ/ mā mā/ mā mā phaṭa/ oṃ dhi ka kro dha ni/ bdag la srungs shig srungs shig swā hā/ oṃ ma hā ba la badz+ra dha ra ka ra ka ra ban+dha ban+dha hūṃ phaṭa swā hā/ oṃ dz+wa la gra sa/ u tsuṣ+ma sang ga ra hūṃ/ rdo rje'i pho nya mo drug cu rtsa bzhi po de dag gis kyang srung ba dang*/ yongs su srung ba dang*/ skyob pa dang sbed pa byed par 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ gang gzungs 'di 'chang ba ni dge bar 'gyur/ dug mi gnod par 'gyur/ shi ba sos par byed par 'gyur/ dgra rnams kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur/ bu mang bar 'gyur/ sa phyogs kyang gsal bar 'gyur ro// gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// las thams cad kyang nus par 'gyur ro// gdug pas zin pa rnams la ni skyor chus 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// dug thams cad kyang dug ma yin par byed par 'gyur ro// mngal na gnas pa'i khye'u dang bu mo yang bde bar btsa' bar 'gyur ro// mdo sde 'di zhag gsum bcangs na rgyas par 'gyur ro// zhag bdun bcangs na zhi ba chen por 'gyur ro// de nas 'byung pa'i bdag po dbang bdag rig sngags 'chang bye ba stong phrag du mas bskor ba 'khor gyi dkyil 'khor de nas langs te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje'i rkang pa la mgo bos phyag 'tshal te/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la 'di skad ces smras so// stobs po che'i bstan pa thogs pa med pa/

stobs dpag tu med pas pha rol gnon pa/ lag na rdo rje dga' ba/ lha dang mi dang lha ma yin dang*/ tshangs pa'i dbang pos phyag byas pa/ gnod sbyin dang srin po dang*/ ro langs dang*/ lus srul po 'jigs par byed pa/ smyo byed dang*/ skrod pa dang*/ gsod pa dang*/ skems byed dang*/ sgo glegs dang*/ 'phrul 'khor dang*/ gtan pa dang*/ rdo rjes rnam par 'joms pa/ las thams cad byed pa/ dkyil 'khor gsang ba dang bcas pa byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen pos bshad du gsol/ de nas thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor gyis 'byung po'i bdag po dbang bdag la byung po'i bdag po legs so legs so zhes bya ba byin no// de nas bcom ldan 'das kyis rdo rje spar te/ rdo rje la zhugs pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs nas/ 'khor gyis dkyil 'khor la rnam par gzigs nas rdo rje mi bzad pa khro bo chen po bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad rnam par 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sems can thams cad la cher snying rje ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ 'od zer 'bar zhing snang ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos thams cad kyi dga' ba kun tu ston pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ bdud thams cad kyi yul 'joms pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ phyag rgya'i mtshan nyid ces bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ sems can thams cad kyi yul zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ mi g.yo ba zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos kyi sku zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ chos kyi sgo zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin dang*/ stobs po che zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin to// de nas bcom ldan 'das lag na rdo rjes rngom bag can du rdo rje spar te/ de nas rdo rje pad+ma la gnas pa'i tshul gyis gnas te/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor kyi dkyil 'khor la rnam par bltas nas/ rdo rje mi bzad pa khro bo 'chol pa lus sbrul gyi ske rags kyis brgyan pa dga' bar byed pa zhes bya ba'i ting nge 'dzin la snyoms par zhugs so// zhugs ma thag tu khro bo 'chol pas gegs bye ba brgya stong phrag du ma 'dar te gzir bar bdag nyid kyis mthong ngo*// de dag tshig nas smre zhing srog btang ste sreg pa'i bskal ba snyam du sems shing nyam thag pa'i skad kyis ngus te/

byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje'i gan du song nas bcom ldan 'das yongs su bskyab tu gsol// byang chub sems dpa' yongs su bskyab tu gsol// bcom ldan 'das bdag cag ni bcom ldan 'das kyi khro bo 'chol pas gzir cing myos te/ phongs nas srog la yang mi lta'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje ting nge 'dzin de las langs te/ bdud kyi dkyil 'khor thams cad la smras pa/ kye ma'o khro bo chen po 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o// mthu che ba'o// de dag gis 'di skad ces smras so// bcom ldan 'das de bzhin te/ kye ma'o khro bo chen po 'di ni rdzu 'phrul che ba'o// mthu che ba'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes seng ge'i lta stangs kyis bltas nas/ 'byung po'i bdag po la khro bo 'chol pa'i dkyil 'khor gsang ba dang bcas pa smras pa/ oṃ badz+ra kro dha ma hā ba la ha na da ha pa tsa ma tha bi dha na sa ya/ dza ṭi lam po da ra u tsuṣ+ma kro dha hūṃ phaṭa/ a ā ma mā hūm̐ swā hā/ grogs po dag gang la la zhig khro bo stobs po che 'di'i dkyil 'khor du bzhugs na de'i don thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// dus ma yin par 'chi ba'i dus byed par mi 'gyur ro// de'i lus la drag po'i las dang*/ nad thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// de la gegs dang*/ mi dang*/ rnam par log 'dren gyis glags rnyed par mi 'gyur ro// skye bo thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro// dgra thams cad med par 'gyur ro// 'dir zhugs na gsang sngags thams cad 'grub par 'gyur ro// khro bo thams cad kyi cho ga yang lhun gyis grub pa nyid du 'grub par 'gyur ro// 'dir dbang bskur na bkra mi shis pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// dpal gyis byin gyis brlabs par 'gyur ro// de nas khro bo chen po lan khris sngar skyed pa byas te/

khro bo chen po'i dkyil 'khor byed pa/ byas pa gzo ba/ rgyud shes pa/ gso sbyong gi yan lag brgyad dang ldan pa/ gsum la skyabs su 'dong pa/ byang chub kyi sems dang ldan pa/ byams pa'i sems dang ldan pa/ snying rje can du gyur pa/ dkyil 'khor mthong ba/ dbang bskur ba/ bla ma rnams kyis lung byin pa/ gang bdud thams cad dang*/ sdang ba'i sems rnam par 'jig par byed pa/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che zhes bya ba 'di 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa de la bdud dang*/ dgra thams cad kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ sha za dang*/ lus srul po dang*/ mkha' 'gro ma dang*/ brjed byed dang*/ sgrub pa dang sbrul 'dzin bcas pa la sogs pa thams cad dang 'jigs pa thams cad las thar par 'gyur ro// dus ma yin par 'chi ba thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bsad pa dang bcings pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bcad pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// rmugs byed dang*/ rengs byed dang*/ rmongs byed la sogs pa'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// klu'i 'jigs pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// bkra mi shis pa thams cad las thar bar 'gyur ro// sems can dbul po gang la la zhig chos kyi rnam grangs 'di dus gsum du 'chang ngam/ klog gam yid la byed dam rjes su dran par byed na/ dbul po'i sdug bsngal thams cad las thar bar byed do// lo nyes byung ba'i tshe stobs po che lan bdun bklags na sprin chen po las char 'bab po/ gal te char mi 'bab na sprin gyi lha rnams kyi srog skam par 'gyur ro// klu'i rgyal po 'khor lo dang*/ klu'i rgyal po mtha' yas dang*/ klu'i rgyal po nag po chen po dang*/ klu'i rgyal po rnams kyis sprin chen po las char 'bebs so// gal te char mi 'bebs na srog skam par 'gyur ro// gong du smos pa'i cho ga bzhin du phyogs kyi cha'am/

klung gi ngogs sam/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram mam/ mchod rten gyi gnas su byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rje la mchod pa chen po byas te/ tsan dan dmar po dang*/ ka ra bi ra'i me tog dang*/ pad+ma dmar po dang*/ a ti mug ta ka'i me tog dang*/ tsam pa ka'i me tog dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan dmar po la sogs pa'am/ bum pa spos chus bkang ba la sogs pas mchod pa byas te/ gang mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa de g.yul ngo thams cad du zhugs kyang pha rol gyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// sems can thams cad dga' bar 'gyur ro// bkra mi shis pa thams cad las rnam par grol bar 'gyur ro// stobs po che rgyal mtshan gyi rtse mo la btags te g.yul ngor song na pha rol gyi dmag tshogs kyis mi tshugs par 'gyur ro// gsang sngags gro ga la bris te spyi bor btags na/ g.yul ngor mtshon cha rnams me tog bzhin du ltung bar 'gyur ro// de nas bdud des bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas te phyogs gcig tu 'dug nas/ stobs po zhes bgyi ba ci lags zhes gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs po che zhes bya ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa'o// stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos so// stobs po che zhes bya ba ni yang dag pa'o// stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos kyi phung po'o// stobs po che zhes bya ba ni chos kyi tshul lo// stobs po che zhes bya ba ni theg pa chen po'o// stobs po che zhes bya ba ni lag na rdo rje'o// de nas bdud sdig can gyis smras pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje legs so legs so// skyabs su mchi'o// sangs rgyas dang chos dang dge 'dun la skyabs su mchi'o// bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so// dge bsnyen gyi yan lag gzung bar bgyi'o// bde dang thar dang mtho ris dang*// mkhas pa dag dang sems can ni// dam pa kun la phan pa'i phyir// stobs po che ni gzung bar bgyi// de nas bdud sdig can chos la dga' zhing yid bde ba dang rang ba gzigs nas// bcom ldan 'das kyis 'di skad ces bka' stsal to// rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i mdo sde 'di ni sems can dmyal ba dang*/

dud 'gro dang*/ yi dwags dang*/ gshin rje'i 'jig rten gyi sdug bsngal las thar bar byed pa'o// de bskal pa stong phrag nyi shur lha'i rgyal po byed par 'gyur ro// bskal pa mtha' yas par gling bzhi la dbang ba'i 'khor lo bsgyur bar 'gyur ro// bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub la 'jog par byed de/ rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che'i snying po 'di ni gtsang sbra can nam/ gtsang spra med pa'am/ smyung bar byas pa'am/ smyung bar ma byas pa'am/ 'khrig pa'i chos la brten pa'ang 'grub par byed do// de la bar chad du mi 'gyur ro// de nas rab 'byor 'khor de nyid du 'dug par gyur pas bcom ldan 'das rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs pa che ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ dam pa ci zhig stsol zhes gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje la dri ba dris shig /rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ lag na rdo rje rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ dam pa ci zhig byin par byed/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ 'bru byin par byed do// gos byin par byed do// dngul byin par byed do// gser byin par byed do// ba glang byin par byed do// dam pa gang 'dod pa'i dam pa de byin par byed do// rab 'byor gyis smras pa/ ci'i 'bras bu zhes bya ba'am/ lag na rdo rjes smras pa/ rab 'byor de de bzhin te// sems can nyon mongs pas bsgribs pa rnams ni 'bras bu'i dus su gnas so sho/ 'bras bu'i dus kyi yon tan gyi don du gnas so// yon tan gyi don gyi bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi lam la 'jog par byed do// rab 'byor gyis smras pa// lag na rdo rje legs so legs so// gsang ba'i mtshan nyid ldan pa ste// stobs po che ni shes rab ldan// gsang ba'i mtshan nyid phun sum tshogs// spyi nas dbang bskur yid kyang gzhungs// mtshan dang yang dag ldan pa ste// sbyin dang tshul khrims shes rab che// rdzu 'phrul che zhing stobs kyang che// dbang cher grags shing bsod nams che// yon tan rtse mo stobs po che// mdo sde 'di la dbang bskur phyir// sangs rgyas brgyad stong der gshegs so// byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes mdo sde 'di nyid kyis mi 'jigs pa'i lag pa spyi bor bzhag ste dge ba byed par 'gyur ro// gang gis gzungs sngags 'di sa 'am/

ri 'am/ klung gi ngogs sam/ rgya mtsho'i 'gram du bcangs na 'jigs pa thams cad kyis 'jigs pa med par 'gyur ro// de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa de bro nad ma mchis par lo brgya 'tsho bar 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rjes yang gsol pa/ chos kyi rnam grangs 'di'i ming ci lags/ 'di ji ltar gzung bar bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'di ni de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya bar zung zhig /chos kyi nyi ma zhes bya bar zung zhig /chos kyi zla bzhes bya bar zung zhig /don thams cad grub pa zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi chos kyi sprin ces bya bar zung zhig /sdig pa thams cad byang bar byed pa'i gzungs sngags zhes bya bar zung zhig /rig sngags 'chang thams cad grub pa'i rgyal po zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /chos kyi dbyings de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che zhes bya bar yang zung zhig /gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rjes su mdo sde 'di 'dzin pa dang*/ 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ yi ger 'brir 'jug pa dang*/ bsti stang du byed pa dang*/ bla mar byed pa dang*/ ri mor byed pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa de 'das pa dang*/ ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba'i sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' rnams la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro// 'das pa dang ma 'ongs pa dang*/ da ltar byung ba rnams kyi mchod rten sku gdung dang bcas pa la mchod pa byas par 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ bcom ldan 'das legs so legs so// shin tu zab pa'i chos bstan pa dang*/

cho 'phrul gyi yon tan gyi rgyan gyi chos bstan pa gzung bar bgyi'o// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje rigs kyi bu'am/ rigs kyi bu mo gang mdo sde 'dis 'chang ba de la sdang ba'i sems can rnams chu 'gram gyi shing ltar ma rung bar 'gyur ro// spos dang*/ me tog dang*/ bdug pa dang*/ rgyal mtshan dang*/ ba dan sna tshogs la sogs pas mchod pa byas na/ bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// de la bar chad mi 'byung bar 'gyur ro// mdo sde 'di gnas gang yang rung ba na 'chang na/ lha dang mir bcas pas mchod pa byed par 'gyur ro// rig sngags kyi rgyal po stobs po che gegs dang rnam par log 'dren thams cad 'ching ba yid la byed nas sangs rgyas brgyad stong dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rnams dang*/ drang srong chen po rnams dang*/ lha dang klu dang dri zar bcas pa rnams dgyes dga'o// stobs po che'i gzungs sngags 'di la dgyes pa'i dus kyi tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas 'di skad ces bka' bstsal to// gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di la gus par mi byed pa de dag sems can dmyal ba chen po brgyad po dag tu skye bar 'gyur ro// gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje su mdo sde 'di la gus par byed pa dang*/ rim gror byed pa dang*/ mchod pa byed pa de bsod nams kyi phung po dpag tu med pa dang ldan par 'gyur ro// yi ger 'bri'am/ tshig mnyan na phyir mi ldog pa'i byang chub kyi lam thob par 'gyur ro// lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ thub pa'i chos bsam gyis mi khyab pa/ shin tu phra ba/ shin tu zab pa/ bsam gyis mi khyab pa la sems can rnams kyi nang nas gang log par sems pa de myos par 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje sems can rnams kyi don gyi phyir mdo sde 'di bshad par bya'o// sems can thams cad kyi sgrib pa bsal ba dang*/

zhi bar bya ba dang*/ rgyas par bya ba dang*/ dbang bskur ba dang*/ bkra mi shis pa thams cad las thar bar bya ba dang*/ dpal gyis byin gyis brlab par bya ba dang*/ sdig pa thams cad byang bar bya ba dang*/ sems can thams cad bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs par byang chub par bya ba'i phyir bshad par bya'o// de'i phyir de bzhin gshegs pa brgyad stong dad par mdzad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pa la lan gsum bskor ba mdzad de/ thal mo sbyar nas legs so rab tu bshad pa legs so zhes mngon par dgyes par mdzad do// de nas de bzhin gshegs pa shākya thub pas sangs rgyas de dag la slar gsungs pa/ bcom ldan 'das de dag legs par rab tu bshad pa legs so legs so// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ stobs po che'i gsang ba'i chos bstan pa 'di'i mthus/ byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rjes sdang ba'i gegs dang rnam par log 'dren thams cad kyi snying 'dar zhing 'gul bar mthong ngo*// dkon mchog sum la phyag 'tshal lo// gnod sbyin gyi sde dpon chen po lag na rdo rje drag po la phyag 'tshal lo// tad+ya thā/ oṃ ha na ha na badz+ra/ da ha da ha badz+ra/ pa tsa pa tsa badz+ra/ ma tha ma tha badz+ra/ dz+wa la pra dz+wa la/ su ru su ru/ mu ru mu ru/ ka taṅka te/ dza ye bi dza ye/ a dzi te/ a pa ra dzi te/ mā ra sai n+ya pra ra ma ra da nā ye swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ gsang ba pa'i bdag po lag na rdo rje/ gegs dang rnam par log 'dren thams cad sdigs shig /chings shig /rnam par choms shig /ma grub pa rnams grub par gyis shig /grub pa rnams dul bar gyis shig /dul ba rnams chud mi za bar gyis shig /sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad 'bad par gyis shig /lha klu thams cad tshur shog tshur shog /ngas stobs po che khro bo'i mthus dge bar bya'o// de nas 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa stan las langs nas bla gos phrag pa gcig tu gzar nas pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/

bcom ldan 'das ga la ba de logs su thal mo sbyar ba btud nas/ bcom ldan 'das la 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das 'du byed thams cad kyi mi rtag pa'i mtshan nyid ji lta bu lags/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ byang chub sems dpa' 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa nyon cig /'du byed thams cad ni dri za'i grong khyer dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni glog dang sprin dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni khyim dang dbu ba dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni mar me dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni chu'i chu bur dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni chu shing dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni ri mo'i rnam pa dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni me tog dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni rmi lam dang 'dra'o// 'du byed 'di dag ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi 'khor lo dang 'dra'o// 'du byed thams cad ni bde ba dang sdug bsngal gyi rlung dang 'dra'o// 'khrugs par 'gyur bas rgya mtsho dang 'dra'o// skar ma dang 'dra'o// sems can rnams ni 'du byed 'di dag skye bar mi sems/ mi mthong mi shes mi 'jal gyi/ de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis gzigs so// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis 'jal to// de bzhin gshegs pa nyid kyis mkhyen to// 'du byed thams cad ni stong pa nyid du mtshan nyid gcig par mkhyen to// don dam pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to/ mtha' las 'das pa stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to// stong pa nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to// chen po stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to// de bzhin nyid stong pa nyid kyi mtshan nyid du mkhyen to// 'jam dpal gzhon nur gyur pa mtshan nyid 'di nyid mthong zhing mtshan nyid 'di nyid shes te/ spyod pa'i byang chub sems dpa' rnams ni sbyin pa'i pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do// de bzhin du tshul khrims dang*/

bzod pa dang*/ brtson 'grus dang*/ bsam gtan dang*/ shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa la spyod do// mtshan nyid 'di nyid shes pa ni byang chub sems dpa' zhes bya'o// de nas byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug gis/ bcom ldan 'das la lan gsum bskor ba byas nas phyogs gcig tu 'dug ste/ 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das mdo sde 'di'i mtshan nyid gang gis na/ ji ltar de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug de bzhin gshegs pa yongs su mya ngan las 'das pa'i dus kyi tshe/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i las rnams byed par 'gyur ro// mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o// mdo sde 'di yongs su nub pa'i dus kyi tshe de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang yongs su nub par 'gyur te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o// mdo sde 'di 'tsho zhing sdod na de bzhin gshegs pa'i bstan pa yang 'tsho zhing sdod de/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o// de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyang mdo sde 'di nyid la phyag 'tshal te/ mtshan nyid des na de bzhin gshegs pa'i sprul pa zhes bya'o// de nas 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug bcom ldan 'das la rjes su yi rangs nas bka' lung bzhin bgyi zhing*/ su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba'i gan du mchi'o zhes gsol pa dang*/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ mdo sde 'di nyid kyi mthus sangs rgyas dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ lha thams cad kyang 'ong ngo*// lha thams cad kyis 'di skad ces gsol to// legs so legs so// bdag cag kyang dam pa stsal bar mngon par dga' ste/ sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyang dam pa 'di nyid stsol bar mdzad par 'gyur ro// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/

gsang ba'i bdag po lag na rdo rje stobs po che gsang ba'i snying po 'di sems can thams cad la bde ba thams cad sbyin par byed pa'o// de nas bcom ldan 'das la byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po lag na rdo rjes 'di skad ces gsol to// bcom ldan 'das mtshan nyid gang gis na mdo sde 'di chos kyi dbyings sngon du 'gro ba zhes bgyi/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad byung nas zhag sum cu rtsa gnyis lon pa'i nyin mo ri btang zung chen por mdo sde 'di nyid kyi chos bsten te/ mtshan nyid des na chos kyi dbyings sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya'o// mdo sde 'di nyid kyi mthus sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad sems dang po bskyed pa gnas te/ mtshan nyid des na chos kyi dbyings sngon du 'gro ba zhes bya'o// mdo sde 'di nyid kyi mthus lha'i bu grangs med dpag tu med pa dag rgyun du zhugs par gyur to// rigs kyi bu su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa de la de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi sras su 'du shes bskyed do// 'khor de nyid du 'chi ba'i dus byas nas mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam la 'jog par mdzad do// lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ sangs rgyas 'khor ba bgrod dka' sems can gyi/ srid pa'i phur pa 'byin cing shes rab kyis// srid phur sems klung 'joms shing thub pa yis// chos bstan pas ni sdig 'joms chos la spyod// bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ lag na rdo rje legs par rab tu bshad pa legs so legs so// lag na rdo rjes gsol pa/ su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pas bsod nams kyi phung po ci zhig 'thob par 'gyur/ bcom ldan 'das kyis bka' stsal pa/ rigs kyi bu su mdo sde 'di 'chang ba dang*/ klog pa dang*/ gzhan dag la yang rgya cher yang dag par rab tu ston pa ni ting nge 'dzin bye ba 'thob par 'gyur ro// sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' 'khor dang bcas pa bye ba mthong bar 'gyur ro// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas rnams kyis sangs rgyas bye ba khrag khrig brgya stong phrag mang po mthong nas/

bsam pa rgya chen pos bsti stang byed par 'gyur ro// bla mar byed par 'gyur ro// rim gror byed par 'gyur ro// mchod par byed par 'gyur ro// chos gos dang*/ bsod snyoms dang*/ mal cha dang*/ na ba'i gsos sman dang*/ yo byad rnams kyang 'bul lo/ byang chub sems dpa' la yang bde bar sbyar ba sgrub bo// dge 'dun gyi tshogs la yang rim gro byed pa ra 'gyur ra ro// dge ba'i rtsa ba de dag kyang bla na med pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i byang chub tu yongs su bsngo bar byed do// de bzhin gshegs pa dgra bcom pa yang dag par rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas de dag la yang bsnyen bkur byed par 'gyur ro// de dag gis chos bstan pa de la yang bsti stang du byas te/ nyan to// len to// 'dzin to// klog go /byang chub sems dpa' lag na rdo rje ji lta ba dang mtshungs par stobs kyis pha rol gnon par 'gyur ro// stobs po che'i pha rol gnon pa khro bo 'di'i mthus bdag dang sems can thams cad swasti swasti/ sid+dhi sid+dhi swā hā/ bcom ldan 'das kyis de skad ces bka' bstsal pa dang*/ 'phags pa byams pa dang*/ 'jam dpal dang*/ 'phags pa spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug la sogs pa bskal pa bzang po'i byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang*/ byang chub sems dpa' sems dpa' chen po rdo rje snying po la sogs pa phyogs bcu'i 'jig rten gyi khams nas 'dus pa de dag thams cad dang*/ lha dang*/ klu dang*/ gnod sbyin dang*/ srin po dang*/ dri za dang*/ lha ma yin dang*/ nam mkha' lding dang*/ mi 'am ci dang*/ lto 'phye chen po dang*/ mi dang*/ mi ma yin pa de dag thams cad dang*/ thams cad dang ldan pa'i 'khor de dag dang*/ lag na rdo rje yang bcom ldan 'das kyis gsungs pa la yi rangs te mngon par bstod do// 'phags pa stobs po che zhes bya ba theg pa chen po'i mdo rdzogs so/// /
